name: get_service_backup_configuration
description: Returns the backup schedule of a ClickHouse service: backupPeriodInHours (interval between backups), backupRetentionPeriodInHours (how long backups stay available), and backupStartTime (UTC HH:MM, present only when a custom start time is set). On failure result is an error object with status "error" and a message.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service whose backup schedule to read. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
